# How to Get Your Online Appointment Link


Each **Yezza Appointment User** will receive a unique **Online Appointment Link** .
This link can be shared via **WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook, TikTok** , or any other platform.


Your customers can:


-


View available appointment slots


-


Select their preferred date and time


-


Make bookings directly through the link


---


## Steps to Find Your Appointment Link


1.


Go to **Clinic Management > Appointment > Settings**


2.


At the top of the page, you will see your **Appointment Link** .


3.


**Copy and save the link** , then share it with your customers.


---


✅ Once shared, customers can immediately check availability and book appointments themselves.
